name: Capileira (Spain)
description: Square flag of three horizontal stripes of blue, yellow and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Capileira (a tree, a tower and a mountain).
history: Municipal flag of Capileira; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Capileira arms — tree, tower and mountain
